drivingQuestion: How does detaching a small amount acquire all the flax?

segments.he: וְאִם הָיָה מְחוּבָּר בְּקַרְקַע, וְתָלַשׁ כׇּל שֶׁהוּא – קָנָה. מִשּׁוּם דְּתָלַשׁ כׇּל שֶׁהוּא – קָנָה?! אָמַר רַב שֵׁשֶׁת: הָכָא בְּמַאי עָסְקִינַן – דְּאָמַר לֵיהּ: לֵךְ, יַפֵּה לְךָ קַרְקַע כׇּל שֶׁהוּא, וְקָנֵי כֹּל מַה שֶּׁעָלֶיהָ.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «And if» the flax «was attached to the ground and he detached any amount,» he has «acquired» it. The Gemara asks: Is it correct to say that «due to» the fact «that he detached any amount,» he «acquired» it? If he does not perform an act of acquisition with all of the flax, how can he acquire all of it? «Rav Sheshet said: Here we are dealing with» a case «where» the seller «said to him: Go» and «clear for yourself any amount of land, and» thereby «acquire everything that is on it.» When the buyer clears the land by detaching the flax from the ground, he is considered to be renting the land and thereby acquires all the flax that grows on it.
